# adv_schema 2
# adv_T_status validity of the temperature of the row: 0 corrected (the steady energy
#   equation was solved and adopted), 1 retained (the run's own T kept: the mass
#   row of the cell is above the fraction below, or the local radiative balance rather
#   than the flow sets it, or the gas enters the cell), 2 failed (the cell solve did not
#   converge or returned an out-of-band root), 3 unsupported (the closure does not
#   cover this cell class), 4 not_evaluated (the post-process did not reach this row).
# adv_comp_status the same five values for the COMPOSITION of the row: 0 the steady
#   advection-ionization solution, 1 the equilibrium composition of the run, 2 a cell
#   solve that did not converge, 3 a cell class the reconstruction does not model, 4 not
#   reached. 3 and 4 are structural and stand above 0, 1 and 2, which name the flow and the
#   solve; the two fields are independent, so a corrected T can carry a retained
#   composition and the reverse.
# adv_status_counts T 18 458 0 26 2 comp 0 477 0 26 1
# adv_mass_row the measure both fields were decided by, for every row of
#   Hydro_ioniz_adv.txt: the operator below, against the fraction below it. It is the
#   CONDITION of the row, so a reader can weigh a corrected row rather than only count it.
# adv_input_certified F no_stationary_claim (see the certification report of the run)
# adv_stationarity_operator face_flux_mass the mass row of the state, |R_1|/s_1 with s_1 the
#   row's own largest term, which is the fractional change of the FACE mass flux across
#   the cell; the same operator the stationary certification measures that row by, and its
#   value for every row is the adv_mass_row column of Hydro_ioniz_adv.txt.
# adv_conditional_tol  1.0E-02 the correction of a corrected row is accurate to this
#   fraction of itself in the mass flux: the terms the correction drops are the ones the
#   mass divergence puts into the steady equations, each of them adv_mass_row times a
#   term they keep, so the product is FIRST ORDER in that measure. A row at or below this
#   fraction is corrected and is a CONDITIONAL correction to it; a row above it is
#   retained. This is not the tolerance of a certified stationary state, which is a
#   statement about the WHOLE state and is reported in the adv_input_certified line.
# adv_product a ONE-WAY correction on the density and velocity field of the input state:
#   rho and v are written back unchanged and nothing solved here feeds back into them. A
#   converged scalar temperature solve therefore does NOT make the row a
#   self-consistent solution: the momentum and mass balances of the corrected pressure were
#   not re-solved, and a profile assembled from corrected and retained cells need not
#   satisfy any interface balance.
# adv_model_restrictions the post-process reconstructs an H/He + trace-metal gas: the
#   molecular (H2 H2p H3p HeHp) and oxygen (OH H2O CO) columns are NOT advection
#   corrected and are the equilibrium solution, those species are absent from the
#   particle and electron counts every equation here is solved with, and the H3+
#   infrared cooling is absent from its energy balance, so the metal and H/He columns
#   inside a molecular layer inherit that approximation.
